patches.from: "Quality changes apply at once; shadows and reflections may take a moment to rebuild."
patches.to: "画质设置立即生效；阴影和反射需要片刻重新生成。"

patches.from: "Breacher, this is Control. The Harbormaster holds the berth. Cut its three uplinks \u2014 yard, shed, quay."
patches.to: "突击队员，这里是指挥中心。港区主控已封锁泊位。切断堆场、仓库、码头的三处中继。"

patches.from: "It has seen you. Gulls fly, Hounds walk. Put them down."
patches.to: "你已被发现！空中有机械飞鸥，地面有机械猎犬。消灭它们。"

patches.from: "One relay dark. It felt that \u2014 machines inbound."
patches.to: "第一处中继已断开。敌方已察觉，机械守卫正在赶来。"

patches.from: "Two dark. It is throwing everything it has left at you."
patches.to: "第二处中继已断开。敌方正全力围攻，小心应对。"

patches.from: "All three dark. The boat is holding at the quay ladder, south end. Run."
patches.to: "三处中继全部断开！撤离艇在码头南端的舷梯旁，快撤！"

patches.from: "You are hit hard. Get behind steel and breathe."
patches.to: "伤势严重！找掩体躲避，稍作恢复。"

patches.from: "Breacher is aboard. Saltline is dark. Good work."
patches.to: "突击队员已登船，港区封锁解除。干得漂亮！"
